title: 6576: State diagram edge label position
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR addresses an issue where edge label in the state diagram was not positioned correctly relative to the edge.
Resolves #6576

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: This kinda feels like a bandaid (which is not a bad thing in itself), do we know why the label was being offset in the first place? Is it possible to fix the root cause?
comments.label_reasoning: The reviewer questions whether the fix addresses the root cause of the label offset issue, implying the current approach may not correctly fix the underlying behavior, which is a semantic deviation concern.

comments.author: darshanr0107
knsv
comments.body: That is correct. If we were to use straight edges and sharp corners, this would not happen. I think the non-band-aid solution is to apply the nice corners we have for elk in all graph-based diagrams as the default. This is good in case anyone wants this more aggressive bezel.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Flags concern that the fix may be a bandaid and suggests investigating/fixing the root cause, implying a potential code change.
